The main takeaway from our work is that

the second-order effect should be taken into account in the design of external prestressed composite beams with corrugated web, and the midspan diaphragm can be adopted to improve the flexural performance of the beam.
the use of a single layer of corrugated steel web can significantly improve the flexural strength of the beam.
the second-order effect can be reduced by increasing the stiffness of external tendons and by using the mid-span diaphram.
